# LuraLoop

LuraLoop is an enterprise AI automation infrastructure company that helps agencies, consultants, and system integrators deploy white-label AI agents and workflow automation for regulated industries including healthcare, education, real estate, and e-commerce.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2025, Kerala, India
- Core architecture: Zero-Data-Retention
- Flagship product: ZIYA AI Agent family
- Business model: B2B2B white-label infrastructure
- Target customers: IT agencies, system integrators, enterprise consultants (not direct end-clients)

## Platform Capability Pages
- /ai-employees: Role-specific AI agents for front-office and internal automation
- /ai-operating-systems: Cross-system intelligent operating layer connecting existing enterprise software
- /multi-agent-infrastructure: Coordinated multi-agent orchestration with delegation and shared context
- /business-process-automation: Workflow automation for recurring, repetitive business processes
- /decision-intelligence: AI-assisted operational decision support and recommendation systems

## Security
LuraLoop operates on a strict zero-data-retention architecture. No client or end-user data is permanently stored. All processing is ephemeral.
